newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Jan-Oct industrial output falls 2.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Jan-Oct industrial output falls 2.4 pct.

text.p: Colombia's industrial output, excluding coffee processing, dropped 2.4 percent in the 10 months to October compared to the same period in 1995, the National Statistics Department said in a communique Sunday.
Industrial output for October alone fell 7.85 percent compared to October 1995.
Including coffee processing, industrial output was down 1.85 percent between January and October compared to last year, the National Statistics Department said.

The production of oil derivatives, plastics, textiles, professional and scientific equipment, tobacco and ceramic and porcelain goods rose slightly, but production of transport equipment, chemicals, paper products, drinks and minerals, excluding metals, was down.
